name: Cobalt ore; underground/open-pit mining; at mine
description: The functional unit for this model is one kilogram of cobalt ore with a cobalt content of 0.47%. The technical scope includes the cradle-to-gate mining of cobalt ore. The system boundary includes incoming transport, mining, and disposal of process wastes. This study adopted the 2017 reserve-weighted average ore grade, which is 2.44% copper and 0.47% cobalt. Primary material, energy, water, and emissions flows for mining were collected from Tenke Fungurume Mining (TFM) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and were converted into an inventory representative of per-unit-mass of cobalt mined.
category: 21: Mining, Quarrying, and Oil and Gas Extraction/2122: Metal Ore Mining

processDocumentation.timeDescription: This unit process is representative of operations from 2007-2014. The material and energy flows for mining at Tenke Fungurume Mining (TFM) were collected in 2014. The water consumption and emissions estimates for TFM were collected in 2007. These data are applicable for next 10 years after 2017, i.e., 2027. This study adopted the 2017 reserve-weighted average ore grade, which is 2.44% Cu, and 0.47% Co.
processDocumentation.geographyDescription: This unit process is representative of average cobalt ore mining in Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Production data were collected from Tenke Fungurume Mining (TFM) in DRC. TFM operates one of the world's largest copper and cobalt mines, situated between the towns of Tenke and Fungurume in Lualaba province, DRC.
processDocumentation.technologyDescription: Open-pit mining is used when the ore is near the surface, whereas underground mining is applied for deeper deposits. This dataset represents a mix of both of these methods, but the percentage is unknown.
processDocumentation.modelingConstantsDescription: This study adopted the 2017 reserve-weighted average ore grade, which is 2.44% Cu, and 0.47% Co. The material and energy flows for mining at Tenke Fungurume Mining (TFM) were collected in 2014 and converted into an inventory representative of per-unit-mass of cobalt mined.
processDocumentation.completenessDescription: Elementary flows are cut-off at less than 1% based on environmental relevance. Technosphere flows are cut-off at less than 1% based on environmental relevance. The mass balance for this process was not calculated
processDocumentation.dataSelectionDescription: Primary material, energy, emissions, and water data were collected from mining operations at Tenke Fungurume Mining (TFM).
processDocumentation.dataTreatmentDescription: The material and energy flows for mining at Tenke Fungurume Mining (TFM) were converted into an inventory representative of per-unit-mass of cobalt mined.
processDocumentation.samplingDescription: The system boundary includes incoming transport (diesel), manufacturing, and disposal of process wastes. The material and energy flows data were collected from mining at Tenke Fungurume Mining (TFM). Uncertainty was not calculated

sources.name: Cobalt Life Cycle Analysis Update for the GREET® Model, 2018

reviews.details: Independent internal review was performed by Argonne National Lab.

processDocumentation.intendedApplication: Situation C1 - Accounting, with system-external interactions - The intended application is a purely descriptive accounting / documentation of the analysed system including existing interactions with other systems in the LCI model. The target audience of this model includes LCA practitioners, industry, and the general public. The direct emissions associated with this dataset come from GREET which considers greenhouse gases, water consumption, and criteria air pollutants, including VOCs, carbon monoxide, nitrogen oxides, particulate matter, and sulfur oxides. Therefore, the following TRACI impact categories are compatible with this dataset: global warming potential, smog formation, and human health – particulate matter. It may be compatible with additional impact categories.
processDocumentation.projectDescription: This project was funded by DOE. These data are cradle-to-gate LCIs for the production of refined cobalt and cobalt chemicals by production stages, which was an update for the GREET model, 2018.

publication.name: Cobalt Life Cycle Analysis Update for the GREET® Model, 2018
